findings.evidence: `closureHomeomorph` at line 232 and `image_frontier_eq_frontier_image` at line 256 both take `hUb : Bornology.IsBounded U`; injectivity alone does not supply surjectivity onto the image closure.
findings.fix: State explicitly in all three places that these conclusions require `Bornology.IsBounded U`.
findings.issue: The module overview omits boundedness when claiming that an injective extension yields a homeomorphism and maps the frontier onto the frontier; the same omission occurs in the main-results summary at lines 67–70 and the theorem docstring at lines 251–255.

findings.evidence: The displayed identity `frontier U = closure U \ U` itself shows the missing closure condition; the proof at line 150 extracts only `hw.2`.
findings.fix: Say that frontier membership strengthens `w ∉ U` by additionally asserting `w ∈ closure U`, and that the theorem uses only its nonmembership component.
findings.issue: The docstring says `w ∈ frontier U` and `w ∉ U` say the same thing for open `U`, but nonmembership does not imply frontier membership.

summary: The documentation overstates the boundary-homeomorphism conclusions and incorrectly equates boundary membership with nonmembership in an open set.
